destination.name: Yancheng
destination.tagline: Salt city on the Yellow Sea coast, gateway to vast wetlands, cranes and reintroduced deer.
destination.description: Yancheng, whose name means Salt City, is a prefecture-level city on Jiangsu's east coast, founded in 119 BC among salt fields. Its coastline holds China's largest coastal wetland reserve, part of a World Heritage site for migratory birds. Père David's deer were reintroduced at Dafeng in 1986 and now number in the thousands. In town, the China Sea Salt Museum traces the salt industry.
whyVisit: See Père David's deer on the coast
Learn how salt shaped the city

goodToKnow.title: Draws lie far from town
goodToKnow.detail: The wetlands, the Dafeng deer reserve and Tiaozini lie on the coast, away from the city centre, so plan on a car or tour.

goodToKnow.title: Winter for cranes
goodToKnow.detail: The best season to see red-crowned cranes is winter. Spring and autumn are milder for cycling and walking in the coastal parks.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: The weather is mild in {months}, while red-crowned cranes are best seen in winter.
